searchText: Question, for the blocks event stream, do all clients stream blocks regardless if it was processed successfully or not? or only when it's successful there are two different block events ```js /** The node has received a block (from P2P or API) that is successfully imported on the fork-choice `on_block` handler */ block = "block", /** The node has received a block (from P2P or API) that passes validation rules of the `beacon_block` topic */ blockGossip = "block_gossip", ``` will double check anything we need to do before cutting a release of the APIs? if we dont have any other changes for fusaka we can go ahead and make a release for it getting some questions about the blob APIs from fusaka onwards https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1423741917769891891 should probably be resolved, yes "resolved" might mean that the status quo is fine, there seems to be a potential emerging consensus on that, but multiple API users are looking at how much they actually need the proofs. responses vary There is a alpha release, but it doesn't update the default view on the explorer, we can wait a few more days until the blobs api discussions are resolved and then cut a release. If changes are needed afterwards can still do a minor/patch release. ah ok missed the proofs thread, thank you

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content:
there are two different block events
```js
  /** The node has received a block (from P2P or API) that is successfully imported on the fork-choice `on_block` handler */
  block = "block",
  /** The node has received a block (from P2P or API) that passes validation rules of the `beacon_block` topic */
  blockGossip = "block_gossip",
```
